scope: ordinary anterior nosebleed without significant trauma
patterns: how do I stop a nose bleed
response: Sit up and lean slightly forward, not back. Pinch the soft part of the nose just below the bony bridge continuously for 10 to 15 minutes and breathe through the mouth. Avoid blowing the nose for a few hours afterwards. A cold pack over the bridge or the back of the neck can help.
red_flags: bleeding is heavy or does not stop after 20 minutes of firm pressure
nosebleed after a significant head or face injury
feeling faint, weak, or short of breath
the person is on blood thinners
repeated nosebleeds in a short time
